The story behind Idyllic Works

From hands-on work to better systems.

Idyllic Works is shaped by hands-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, and process improvement across the Philippines, Malaysia, and Taiwan.

A significant part of that experience comes from the semiconductor industry. It includes maintaining high-precision equipment used in microchip and integrated circuit (IC) production in Muntinlupa and Laguna, Philippines; working as a Maintenance and Process Engineer in Butterworth and Ipoh, Malaysia; and serving as a Project Engineer in Taoyuan, Taiwan. It also includes visits to companies such as TSMC in Taiwan and One Solar Energy in Malaysia.

In Hermosa, Bataan, Philippines, this experience included serving as both a Production Supervisor and a Process Improvement Supervisor for a Japanese-owned wiring systems company.

Today, that journey continues in the Philippines as an entrepreneur in the health and wellness industry.
